short: A Chinese AI company known for its long-context Kimi models and assistant.
definition: Moonshot AI is a Chinese AI company known for its Kimi models and assistant, including long-context and open-weight releases that drew attention for strong coding performance and agentic ability (acting in multiple steps and using tools to reach a goal). Its most prominent recent release, Kimi K3 (July 2026), topped coding leaderboards among open-weight models. It competes among Chinese labs developing frontier language models, alongside DeepSeek.
